title: refactor: decompose ExpressionResolver into deep modules

raw.title: refactor: decompose ExpressionResolver into deep modules
raw.body:
## What
Decomposes the `ExpressionResolverInterface` God-Object into 5 highly-localized deep modules to restore testability and locality, as per the architecture review.

## Details
- Created `RequestCompilerInterface`, `OutputExtractorInterface`, `CriteriaEvaluatorInterface`, `SchemaValidatorInterface`, and `ExpressionEvaluatorInterface`
- Built 5 distinct implementations.
- Transitioned the original monolithic `ArazzoExpressionResolver` into a `@deprecated` facade to maintain backward compatibility.
- Fragmented monolithic tests into 5 targeted test suites.
